notes: Accepted residual npm audit baseline. All entries are TRANSITIVE dependencies of two renderer packages — @excalidraw/excalidraw (the whiteboard/diagram surface) and @wesbos/code-icons (icon font) — pulled in via the mermaid-to-excalidraw / chevrotain / langium chain and the code-icons build tooling. The advisories are prototype-pollution / code-injection in lodash-es, non-integer nanoid IDs, and dev-server / server.fs issues in esbuild+vite (build-time tooling, not shipped to the packaged renderer). None are reachable by a remote party in a local-first packaged desktop app: there is no exposed dev server in production, and the vulnerable lodash/nanoid paths are internal to the diagram parser. Proper fix is a follow-on major bump of @excalidraw/excalidraw + @wesbos/code-icons (breaking, needs whiteboard UI regression testing) tracked separately from this security/correctness pass. Do not add entries for FIRST-PARTY or fixable-by-minor-bump advisories without documenting why they cannot be patched safely.
